create_timing_ctx: create a TimingCtx instance to track elapsed time for named code blocks using context manager syntax
use_timing_ctx_start_stop: use TimingCtx start and stop methods to manually time code sections with named keys
print_timing_summary: print a formatted table of timing summaries with total and mean milliseconds per key using pprint
create_subcontext: create a nested subcontext with TimingCtx create_subcontext to track timings from inner function calls
compare_multiple_timings: compare multiple TimingCtx instances with pprint_multi to print aggregated mean and max timing statistics
